notes: 0.3.32：反馈链路去令牌化 + 关单收紧。读不再依赖令牌——公开仓库的 Issue 列表匿名就能读（实测 200，60 次/小时每 IP），所以有令牌先带令牌读，令牌失效或没有就自动退回匿名读；新机器没配令牌打开面板也能直接看到已有反馈。没有令牌也能提交——面板把标题、正文和环境块预填进 GitHub 的新建 Issue 页面（issues/new?title=&body=&labels=feedback），浏览器里登录了 GitHub 点一下提交即可，不需要 token；这条只在没有令牌时启用，有令牌仍走 API 直发，能进队列、能补发。关单限制为「只有仓库所有者」——服务端每次改状态前用 GET /user 认令牌归属，login 与仓库所有者不一致直接 403，面板上「已解决」按钮同步置灰显示「仅所有者」，别人的令牌即使填进面板也关不掉单。连接行改成三态：已用 X 登录（可提交、可关单）/ 令牌不属于所有者（只能读和写）/ 匿名读取（提交走浏览器）。
notesEn: 0.3.32: token-free reading + owner-only closing. Reading no longer needs a token - the Issue list of a public repo is readable anonymously (verified 200, 60 requests/hour per IP), so it tries the token first and falls back to an anonymous read when the token is missing or expired; a fresh machine without any token opens the panel and sees existing feedback right away. Submitting without a token works too - the panel prefills title, body and environment block into GitHub new-issue page (issues/new?title=&body=&labels=feedback); with GitHub signed in on the browser, one click submits it, no token needed. That path is only used when no token exists; with a token the API path still applies (queued and reflushable). Closing is limited to the repo owner - before changing state the server checks GET /user, and a token whose login differs from the repo owner gets 403; the Resolve button is disabled with "Owner only" in the panel, so a foreign token cannot close issues even if pasted in. The connect row now has three states: signed in as X (submit and close) / token not the owner (read and submit) / anonymous read (submit via browser).
